- [**rust-theft-auto: reimplementing the original Grand Theft Auto engine**](https://github.com/gaudecker/rust-theft-auto) - rust-theft-auto reimplements the original Grand Theft Auto engine in Rust using map and style files from a player's installation. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/rust-theft-auto-case/)</sub>
- [**RustyWorld: a Rust reimplementation of the Another World engine**](https://github.com/EdMcBane/rustyworld) - RustyWorld reimplements the Another World game engine in Rust and runs on the user's original data. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/rustyworld-case/)</sub>
- [**San Andreas Unity: a GTA San Andreas engine reimplementation in Unity**](https://github.com/in0finite/SanAndreasUnity) - Reimplements the Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas engine in Unity (C#), loading the archives, RenderWare models and textures, collision, animations, audio, text and item definitions from the user’s own PC installation. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/san-andreas-unity-engine-case/)</sub>
- [**ScummVM: replacement executables for classic adventure games**](https://github.com/scummvm/scummvm) - Replaces the executables of classic adventure games and RPGs with one program that runs the user's original data files. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/scummvm-engine-case/)</sub>
- [**Seedra: reimplementing Minecraft Legacy Console Edition world generation**](https://github.com/UtterEvergreen1/Seedra) - Seedra reimplements Minecraft Legacy Console Edition world generation in a C++ library. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/seedra-case/)</sub>

- [**Settlers.ts: decoding Settlers 4 data for a browser remake**](https://github.com/tomsoftware/Settlers.ts) - Settlers.ts builds a browser-based Settlers 4 remake in TypeScript using files from the user's game installation. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/settlers-ts-case/)</sub>

- [**SiegeFX: a Dungeon Siege engine reimplementation in alpha**](https://github.com/codingncaffeine/SiegeFX) - A C#/.NET 10 engine loads Dungeon Siege's original archives, scripts and models, with published alpha builds and an audit/parity ledger. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/siegefx-dungeon-siege-engine-case/)</sub>

- [**T.O.R.E-Fighters: rebuilding Jane's Fighters Anthology in Rust**](https://github.com/john-overton/T.O.R.E-Fighters) - T.O.R.E-Fighters rebuilds Jane's Fighters Anthology in Rust around observed player-visible behavior. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/tore-fighters-case/)</sub>

- [**Thyme: Command &amp; Conquer Generals: Zero Hour reimplementation**](https://github.com/TheAssemblyArmada/Thyme) - Thyme is an open source reimplementation of Command &amp; Conquer Generals: Zero Hour. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/thyme/)</sub>
- [**TM2020-Sim: extending Trackmania physics simulation**](https://github.com/Speedstu/TM2020-Sim-V1) - TM2020-Sim extends Gearbox's Trackmania physics and asset loading into a headless simulator with a native C++ and Rust SDK. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/tm2020-sim-trackmania-case/)</sub>
- [**TOD Tools: reconstructing Total Overdose and Kapow Engine**](https://github.com/Michael0ne/TOD_tools) - TOD Tools reconstructs Total Overdose game and Kapow Engine code in C++. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/tod-tools-case/)</sub>
- [**Torchlight Rekindled: a portable engine following the Xbox 360 game**](https://github.com/GreenSwampDweller/torchlight-rekindled) - Torchlight Rekindled implements an engine for the 2009 game Torchlight, following the logic of its Xbox 360 release. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/torchlight-rekindled-case/)</sub>
- [**touhou-engine: a Python reimplementation of Touhou gameplay**](https://github.com/SaigyoujYuyuko/touhou-engine) - touhou-engine reimplements Touhou danmaku gameplay in Python, with TH07: Perfect Cherry Blossom as its reference game. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/touhou-engine-case/)</sub>
- [**Untangle: a browser rebuild from REA and Ghidra evidence**](https://github.com/az9713/untangle-rebuild) - An author-documented REA/Ghidra investigation of the shipped Untangle Windows binary produces a single-page playable rebuild and a claim-by-claim grading receipt. <sub>Case study · Mixed workflow · Also: Binary · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/untangle-rea-evidence-rebuild-case/)</sub>
- [**vakfu: reconstructing Wakfu map rendering**](https://github.com/jac3km4/vakfu) - vakfu reconstructs Wakfu's isometric map rendering in a Rust application that loads assets from the user's game copy. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/vakfu-case/)</sub>
- [**Vange-rs: reimplementing Vangers in Rust**](https://github.com/kvark/vange-rs) - vange-rs reimplements Vangers in Rust with wgpu graphics, aiming to reproduce its worlds, vehicles and single-player behavior using original game resources. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/vange-rs-vangers-case/)</sub>
- [**Vault Engine: rebuilding Fallout and Fallout 2 in Rust**](https://github.com/mikyowski-ui/vault-engine) - Vault Engine reimplements Fallout and Fallout 2 as a Rust engine that reads the user's retail DAT archives. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/vault-engine-case/)</sub>
- [**VERA20K: rebuilding Red Alert 2: Yuri's Revenge in Rust**](https://github.com/YuriPlanet/vera20k) - VERA20K rebuilds the Red Alert 2: Yuri's Revenge engine in Rust while reading the user's original game files. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/vera20k-case/)</sub>
- [**wage-engine: a World Builder adventure engine reimplementation**](https://github.com/asvitkine/wage-engine) - wage-engine reimplements the World Builder engine for classic Mac graphic text adventures in Java. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/wage-world-builder-engine-case/)</sub>
- [**War1: a C reimplementation of Warcraft: Orcs &amp; Humans**](https://github.com/acoto87/war1) - War1 reimplements Warcraft: Orcs &amp; Humans in C as an RTS engine that reads the original game's DATA.WAR assets. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/war1-warcraft-remake-case/)</sub>
- [**Weltall: rebuilding Xenogears in Unreal Engine 5**](https://github.com/Roman215/Weltall) - Weltall rebuilds the PlayStation game Xenogears as a native Unreal Engine 5 port that reads content from the user's disc images. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/weltall-xenogears-case/)</sub>
- [**WinTex: an Under a Killing Moon engine reimplementation**](https://github.com/ElakaSnarne/WinTex) - WinTex reimplements a Windows-native engine for Under a Killing Moon using files from the original game. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/wintex-under-a-killing-moon-case/)</sub>
- [**Wizardry 6: reconstructing game formats and systems**](https://github.com/martydill/Wizardry-6-reverse-engineering) - Wizardry 6 investigates the data formats and systems of Bane of the Cosmic Forge, with parsers and viewers for graphics, maps, scenario records, text and sound. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/wizardry-6-reconstruction-case/)</sub>
- [**Wolfenstein (2009) SP: reconstructing the single-player engine**](https://github.com/CheffCorleOne/wolf2009-sp) - Wolfenstein (2009) SP rebuilds single-player engine behavior in C++ on idTech4A++, using game data from the user's PC copy. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · Also: Binary · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/wolfenstein-2009-sp-case/)</sub>
- [**X-Settlers: reconstructing Settlers 3/4 maps and rendering**](https://github.com/skarmux/x-settlers) - X-Settlers is an early C++17 reimplementation effort for The Settlers 3/4 that renders map terrain and documents Settlers 3 map partitions. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/x-settlers-case/)</sub>
- [**xoreos: an open reimplementation of BioWare’s Aurora engine family**](https://github.com/xoreos/xoreos) - Reimplements BioWare’s Aurora engine and its later derivatives as a portable C++ engine that runs on the user’s installed game data, targeting nine games from Neverwinter Nights to Dragon Age II. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/xoreos-aurora-engine-case/)</sub>
- [**YodaStoriesNG: rebuilding Yoda Stories and Indiana Jones from their data files**](https://github.com/sp00nznet/YodaStoriesNG) - YodaStoriesNG reimplements Star Wars: Yoda Stories and Indiana Jones and His Desktop Adventures in C# and SDL2 using each game's original data file. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/yodastoriesng-case/)</sub>
- [**z2rs: an incremental Rust reconstruction of Zelda II checked against an emulator**](https://github.com/troyedwardsjr/z2rs) - Rebuilds Zelda II: The Adventure of Link (NES) in Rust for desktop, browser and Android by replacing the game’s 6502 routines one at a time. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/z2rs-zelda2-reconstruction-case/)</sub>
- [**Zelda3: a C reimplementation of A Link to the Past**](https://github.com/snesrev/zelda3) - Zelda3 reimplements The Legend of Zelda: A Link to the Past in C, extracting levels and images from the user's US SNES ROM. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/zelda3-case/)</sub>

## Other methods and analyses

- [**accd: reconstructing the Assetto Corsa Competizione dedicated server**](https://github.com/renaudallard/assettocorsa_competizione_server) - accd reconstructs the Assetto Corsa Competizione dedicated server in C99 for Linux and BSD systems. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · Also: Protocol · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/accd-assetto-corsa-competizione-server-case/)</sub>
- [**AFS Volume 2.00 specification: reconstructing Tenchu archives**](https://github.com/stedestro/AFS200Tools) - AFS200Tools documents the AFS Volume 2.00 archive format found in PlayStation Tenchu games. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/afs200tools-case/)</sub>

- [**alive-serv: reconstructing the SIF2 MIRACLE LIVE! server**](https://github.com/miraclealive/alive-serv) - alive-serv reconstructs part of the SIF2 MIRACLE LIVE! <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · Also: Protocol · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/alive-serv-case/)</sub>

- [**AZMCO: reconstructing Motor City Online and its renderers**](https://github.com/americusmaximus/AZMCO) - AZMCO reconstructs parts of Motor City Online, including an offline launcher and DirectX renderer modules. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · Also: Binary · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/azmco-case/)</sub>

- [**battlepod: reconstructing the BattleTech arcade cockpit**](https://github.com/sp00nznet/battlepod) - battlepod reconstructs the Virtual World Entertainment BattleTech cockpit as a bring-up harness and playable emulator. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · Also: Firmware, Protocol · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/battlepod-case/)</sub>
- [**Betrock++: reimplementing the Minecraft Beta 1.7.x server**](https://github.com/OpenBetaGroup/BetrockPlusPlus) - Betrock++ reimplements the Minecraft Beta 1.7.x server in C++, aiming to replace the Java server while prioritizing compatibility. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/betrockplusplus-case/)</sub>
- [**Between Us: an offline remake informed by Action ou Vérité APK analysis**](https://github.com/rockyanyan/between-us) - Between Us is an offline couple game rebuilt after analysis of the Action ou Vérité Android APK. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · Also: App · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/between-us-android-remake-case/)</sub>
- [**bf-private-server: a Brave Frontier revival server**](https://github.com/joppe2001/bf-private-server) - bf-private-server recreates a self-hosted server for Brave Frontier client version 2.19.6. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · Also: Protocol · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/bf-private-server-case/)</sub>
- [**Casiolator: reimplementing Casio PV-1000, PV-2000 and Loopy consoles**](https://github.com/vs-sr-dev/casiolator) - Casiolator emulates the Casio PV-1000, PV-2000 and Loopy cartridge consoles using its own Z80, SH-1, video and sound implementations. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/casiolator-case/)</sub>

- [**cor64: C# Nintendo 64 emulator**](https://github.com/bdragoncore/cor64) - cor64 is a work-in-progress Nintendo 64 emulator written in C#. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/cor64/)</sub>

- [**CyberStrike Server Specification: DOS client protocol and map format**](https://github.com/mmq/cyberstrike-spec) - CyberStrike Server Specification reconstructs the server-facing behavior of the 1994 DOS client of CyberStrike from observation of the client and its printed manual. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · Also: Protocol · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/cyberstrike-server-specification-case/)</sub>
- [**d2-dedicated-server: reconstructing a Diablo II realm and game-server stack**](https://github.com/jaenster/d2-dedicated-server) - d2-dedicated-server rebuilds a self-hosted Diablo II realm and headless game-server stack. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · Also: Protocol · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/d2-dedicated-server-case/)</sub>

- [**DARK: reconstructing the video plugin path for Proton cutscenes**](https://github.com/Lintech-1/dark-render-re) - dark-render-re reconstructs the video texture upload path used by DARK (2013) to restore WMV cutscenes under Proton. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/dark-render-re-case/)</sub>

- [**Defender: annotated arcade disassembly**](https://github.com/AaronBottegal/Defender-Source-Code) - Defender-Source-Code documents the Williams Defender arcade game in an annotated disassembly. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/defender-arcade-disassembly-case/)</sub>

- [**Diep.io Parser: reconstructing game packet structure**](https://github.com/Altanis/diep-lb-bot) - Diep.io Parser documents packet structures used by the Diep.io game client and server. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · Also: Protocol · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/diep-lb-bot-case/)</sub>
